assumptions.session: 09:45 <= entry < 15:45 New York; last-observed-price flatten at cutoff
assumptions.entry: After observed overshoot, two progressive ordinary/overshoot reversal events in same excursion; new extreme/DC resets count; reverse primary direction; next tick fill; one attempt per excursion; only in-window reversals counted
assumptions.stop: Freeze BandSize from second reversal signal; adverse 1-band distance from actual fill, rounded inward to quarter point; first touching/crossing raw trade price
assumptions.profit_exit: First ordinary/overshoot reversal after favorable overshoot in position direction; next tick fill; DC resets profit arm
assumptions.loss_definition: Any realized negative gross trade; halt new entries only if the configured daily count is reached; None disables the limit
assumptions.watermark_rule: Arm only after gain >2 frozen entry bands; watermark starts at +2 bands of signed profit and advances at each further whole-band gain; never retreats; exit first raw trade strictly below the signed watermark; protective stop takes priority, then watermark, then pending original profit exit
assumptions.costs: No commissions, quote spread or latency; actual stop gaps are retained; ideal stop-price P&L separately reported
